text.en:
BRUNEI DARUSSALAM GOVERNMENT GAZETTE No. S 25

PORTS ENACTMENT, 1981 {E. 12 of 1982) Notification under Section 1 In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 1 of the Ports Enactment, 1981 His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan of Brunei Darussalam has appointed the 1st day of January, 1986, as the d~te on which the said Enactment shall come into operation. Dated this 16th day of December, 1985.

BY COMMAND

PENGIRAN BAHRIN (Pengiran Laila Kanun Diraja)

MINISTER OF COMMUNICATIONS
